facts.text: Caroline expressed gratitude for the support she received from friends, family, and people she looked up to during her transition and acceptance journey.

evidence.quote: Thanks, Melanie. Transitioning wasn't easy and acceptance wasn't either, but the help I got from friends, family and people I looked up to was invaluable.
Thanks, Melanie. Your support really means a lot. This journey has been amazing and I'm grateful I get to share it and help others with theirs.

facts.text: Caroline believes that offering love and support to others is empowering and brings her joy.

evidence.quote: That's why I want to pass that same support to anyone who needs it. Bringing others comfort and helping them grow brings me such joy.

facts.text: Melanie expressed admiration for Caroline's journey and her ability to help others, calling her inspiring.

evidence.quote: You found your true self and now you're helping others. You're so inspiring!
Absolutely! I'm so glad we can always be there for each other.

facts.text: Caroline mentioned that being able to share her journey and help others with theirs is a gift.

evidence.quote: I'm grateful I get to share it and help others with theirs. It's a real gift.
